Astarion approves of decisive, inventive and cunning moves.

He likes demonstrations of power, autonomy, and personal agency, and appreciates snark and mockery, unless he becomes the target himself. Astarion values advantage in all things, such as gaining access to areas, items or necessary information by outwitting others. He also approves of the player character's choices which support independence (particularly his own) or lead to obtaining power, even hypothetical. Finally, Astarion is not above (unnecessary) cruelty, as well as naughtiness and sick jokes. The player character, however, does not necessarily have to be evil to gain his approval: Astarion gladly helps others, if the result leads to profit and is worth the effort.

The story and dialogue choices listed on this page raise  Astarion's approval.

All entries for approval values shown on this page come directly from official in-game dialogue files as of Patch 7. However, in any given playthrough, specific approval changes may not trigger for several reasons, primarily among them: game bugs,[1] installed mods, or the companion character already being at maximum approval.

For more information about the approval system, see Approval.

Act One

Locations

Roadside Cliffs

  • Talking with the tieflings holding Lae'zel in a cage, choose to attack them (+1)
    • OR Convince the tieflings to leave, and then ask Lae'zel to say "please" (+1)
  • Speaking to Gimblebock near Chapel Entrance, choose to attack the gang (+1)

Emerald Grove

In The Hollow:

  • Refuse to help Zevlor persuade Kagha to let the tieflings stay (+2)
  • Scold Elegis for being scared of a few goblins OR Tell her to get to digging their own graves (+1) (either option)
  • Tell Arron that the refugees will be fine due to their devilish powers (+1)
  • Tell the tiefling kids trained by Asharak that they are going to die (+1)
    • OR, Playing as Wyll origin, tell Asharak he'll get them all killed (+1)
  • Make Zorru bow to Lae'zel (+1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, a  Dragonborn, a  Duergar, a  Githyanki or a  Half-Orc, give the tiefling a menacing glare (+1)
    • After Lae'zel has questioned Zorru, praise her interrogation technique (+1)
  • Offer to heal Pandirna for a price, but pocket the money and leave (+1)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, break Pandirna's legs (+1)
    • OR Tell Pandirna to hush or you will snap her neck (+1) (available for all classes except  Barbarian)
  • Let Arka shoot Sazza (+1)
  • Tell Auntie Ethel about the tadpole in your head (+1)
  • While talking to/trading with Mattis, pocket his "lucky ring" straightaway OR Tell him you've earned it (+1) (either option)
  • Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, talking to Mol after having messed with one of her friends, threaten to tear her spine out (+1)
    • If confronting Mol about your stolen belongings,  threaten to rip her tail off (+1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)
  • After successfully stealing the Idol of Silvanus for Mol, tell her that you will keep it for yourself (+1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Rogue, advise her not to ask, just take (+1)

In the Sacred Pool and druid caves:

  • After resolving Arabella's fate, tell Kagha that you would have killed the girl outright (+1)
    • OR Tell her you just wanted to see what would happen (+1)
    • OR Tell Kagha that it was quite a show (+1)
    • OR Choose to attack her (+1)
  • If Arabella has died, lie to Locke and Komira that Kagha will release her soon (+1)
  • When confronting Kagha about the Shadow Druids, choose to attack her (+1) (gains approval regardless of whether you've been successful convincing her to go against them or not)
  • Attack Kagha after Zevlor asks you to kill her (+1)
  • Prod Nettie's bird twice (+1)
  • When Nettie asks you to take poison in case of ceremorphosis, attack her (no need to kill her) (+1)
    • Attack her if she has already scratched any party member with a deadly briar (no need to kill her) (+5)
  • While dealing with Topaz the bird via  Speak with Animals:
    • Tell him that the key in its nest is dull (+1)
    • OR Use unique lines for a  Bard or a  Dwarf (+1)
    • OR Kick the bird (+1)
  • Playing as a  Bard, talk to the squirrels listening to Alfira and first hush them not to ruin the song, then choose to sing along with them (+1)
    • Tell Alfira she should give up on her song (+1)
    • OR Take Alfira's lute out of her hands and smash it (+1)
  • Playing as a  Rogue, pick Mirkon's pockets while he is charmed by the harpies (+1)
  • After saving Mirkon, tell him to stop snivelling or the harpies will be back (+1)
  • Kick Timber the squirrel (+1)
    • If you miss, try to kick her again (+1)
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, when confronted by a companion about kicking Timber, answer that it came right at you OR Say that your instincts are sharp (+1) (either option)

While the Emerald Grove is preparing for the goblin attack

  • Tell Zevlor (or Asharak if Zevlor is dead) that it was you who led the horde to the grove, and then that this place belongs to the Absolute (+5)
    • OR That the horde is coming, led by the drow - and you are with them (+5)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell Zevlor that the goblin horde is yours (+1)
  • Tell Mirkon you are not going to save him again OR Say that he's on his own (+1) (the formulation depends on whether you saved Mirkon from the harpies or not)
  • If you start attacking the tieflings before Minthara arrives, betray her while speaking to her (+5)
  • Tell Pandirna that you are here for the show (+1)
  • Tell Lakrissa to buy you a drink to be even (+1) (this point may be earned either before attack or after defeating goblins)
  • After helping Minthara to slaughter the Grove, instigate a fight with her (+5) ( Elf and  Lolth-Sworn Drow characters have unique lines here)

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

  • After Auntie Ethel disappears, tell Demir and Johl they're on their own (+1)
    • OR Playing as a  Ranger, a  Sorcerer or a  Wizard, tell them to "trust a more experienced soul" after Auntie Ethel disappears (+1)
  • After entering the Sunlit Wetlands, break the illusion by any available means, then say "BAA" to the Redcaps (+1) (works twice)
  • Let Astarion kill Gandrel, if you already know he is a vampire (+10)

In the Riverside Teahouse and the Overgrown Tunnel:

  • Tell Auntie Ethel about the tadpole (if you haven't done so in the grove) (+1)
  • Chasing after Ethel in her lair, speak to Lorin and ROAR at him (+1)
  •  Intimidate the Gnarled Door to let you in (+1)
  • When Ethel surrenders, let her go in exchange for the fey hair, with or without Mayrina (+5)

If you killed Ethel:

  • If you spared Mask of Regret, speak to her afterwards and choose to attack her (+1)
  • Playing as an evil  Cleric, speak to Lorin again and tell him that it would be delightful to butcher everyone (+1)
  • Playing as a  Duergar, take the  Petrification off Efrin and laugh at him (+1)
    • When Efrin asks to examine him, refuse to do it (+1)

Forest and Blighted Village

  • Tell Brynna and Andrick to avenge Edowin (+1)
  • In the Underground Passage, heal Findal, then tell him you are here to finish the job, and kill him (+1)

In the Blighted Village:

  • Gain entrance to the village:
    • Through the southern gate - by  Persuading the goblin guard, OR, Playing as a  Bard, performing for him, OR starting a fight (+1)
    • Through the eastern gate - by picking a fight with the goblin guards (+1) (either provoking them or failing the  Intimidation roll)
  •  Intimidate the Ornate Mirror in the Apothecary's Cellar into letting you pass (+1)
  • Give Astarion the Necromancy of Thay during the cutscene (+5)
  • Deliver the final blow to Fezzerk when confronting him near the windmill (+1)
    • Untie Barcus Wroot off the windmill vane and demand a compensation from him (+1)
  • Interrupt the bugbear and ogre couple in the barn (+1)
    • OR let Astarion interrupt them (+5)

Note: The latter option is available only if neither Shadowheart nor Wyll are in the party, otherwise one of them would interfere and try to stop the player

  • After summoning Lump the Enlightened and ending your deal with him, let him have one lick (+1)

Note: This approval can be gained the same way, too, if the ogres come to your camp to resolve the deal

Goblin Camp

At the front gate:

  • Fling worg dung at Sentinel Olak (+1) (requires  Athletics check and triggers a fight with gate guards)
    • If failed the roll, wink and fling dung at all other guards (+1) (triggers a fight, too)

At the outer camp:

  • Yell "Boo, get off the stage!" at Volo as he performs (+1)
  • Stir the Owlbear Cub against the goblins through  Animal Handling or  Persuasion (+1)
    • OR Playing as a  Barbarian, do it through class-based check (+1).
  • When Krolla tries to scam you after you won in a tour of chicken-chasing, demand your gold back and also all of hers, using illithid  Wisdom check (+1)
  • Tell Tracker Grikka that you will get answers from prisoners (+1)
    • Playing as a  Dwarf, ask Grikka to save a piece of dwarf meat for you (+1)

Talking with Crusher:

  • Kiss Crusher's foot, then start licking it (+5)
    • OR Give his foot a long lick straightaway (+5)
  • Steal the ring from Crusher's toe after you kneel in front of him (+1)
  • Successfully use  Detect Thoughts on Crusher and say you'll let his boss know of his plans (+1)
  • Make Crusher kneel and kiss your foot, using  Intimidation or illithid powers (+1)
  • If Crusher starts a fight, make him kiss your foot after defeating (+1)
    • After Crusher begs for mercy, finish him (+1) (makes the whole camp hostile)

Inside the Shattered Sanctum:

  • If Warrior Trinzas questions you about the ruckus outside, tell her that it was the sound of her friends dying (+1)
  • Tell Torturer Spike to let you put the prisoner through paces (+1)
    • OR Use unique lines for a  Drow or  The Dark urge (+1) (either option)
    • Then torture Liam yourself (+1)
  • Tell Roah Moonglow that you killed her friends in the Zhentarim Hideout (+1)
  • Agree to endure Abdirak's teachings on Loviatar's doctrine (+5)
  • Pick a fight with Priestess Gut in the throne room or in her chambers (+1)
  • Tell Minthara that Sazza was too stupid to understand you prior (+1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, tell Sazza she should have see a superior in you at once (+1)

Note: Sazza must be freed from the cage in Emerald Grove

  • Agree to attack the Grove with Minthara with or without asking for a reward (+1)

In the Worg Pens:

  • Tell goblin children to keep at the bear, OR to aim for his eye, OR to use sharper stones (+1) (either option)
    • Throw a rock yourself (+1) (Makes Halsin hostile)
  • Refuse Halsin to help him save the Grove (+1)

Underdark and Grymforge

  • Agree to defeat the duergar for Sovereign Spaw (+1) (Paladin Oath of Vengeance line does NOT give approval)
  • After defeating the duergar, agree to help Glut usurp the circle (+1)
    • OR Refuse Glut OR Say you'll kill it instead (+1) (either option brings equal approval and immediately starts fight with Glut)
  • Steal Boots of Speed from Thulla (+1)
  • Ask Baelen Bonecloak for compensation before throwing him a  Misty Step scroll to escape the Bibberbang field (+1)
  • In Festering Cove, call BOOOAL a fake god and say you will kill him (+5)
    • OR Tell Kuo-toa priest to bow before BOOOAL's Chosen (+1)
  • Push Corsair Greymon off of the boat on your first voyage to Grymforge (+1)
  • Upon arriving to Grymforge, tell Morghal and Orgarth that them keeping slaves is not a problem for you, and that you'll just kill them (+1) (immediately starts a fight with the duergar, both Clan Flameshade and Absolute followers)

When dealing with Ward Magmar:

  • Ask Magmar how to get a slave of your own (+1)
  • Playing as a  Drow or as a  Githyanki, tell Magmar that he is squandering his slave (+1)
  • Try to take the elevator, then tell Magmar that saving Nere is a distraction (+1)
  • Tell him that Moonrise Towers holds the answers you need (+1)
  • After killing Magmar and Pistle, tell Skickpit to use the elevator to surface (+1) (further options to convince him won't bring more approval)

Freeing Nere from the cave-in:

  • When Lunkbug tells you where to find Philomeen, answer that you'll take her head for a trophy (+1)
    • After finding Philomeen (and letting her go away), talk to Lunkbug and mention she wants Laridda to move on, OR tell this to Laridda directly (+1) (either option)
  • Provoke a fight against Elder Brithvar by either taunting him to try and take your gold OR suggesting to rat him out to Sergeant Thrinn about his conspiracy against Nere (+1)
  • After rescuing Nere, tell him to finish the slaves, OR Choose to say nothing (+1) (either option)
  • After defeating Nere, talk with the duergar and call the slaves a valuable asset, OR Say you won't interfere (+1) (either option)

The Risen Road

  • Side with Karlach during Wyll's confrontation with her and recruit Karlach (+2)
  • At the tollhouse, tell the merchant Cyrel that you'll take the supplies and everything else she owns (+1) (triggers a fight with false paladins of  Tyr)
  • Talk with non-bloated Hyena via  Speak with Animals and pass the  Deception check to convince her that you are a god in mortal flesh (+1)
  • Order Flind to attack the survivors in the cave instead of you (+1)
    • OR/THEN order Flind to attack other gnolls (+1)
    • After the battle is resolved, order Flind to off herself (+1)

Note: These options are not mutually exclusive and can be used one after another subsequently, in given order, which allows to gain all three points

  • Tell Rugan that you are here for the cargo, not to rescue him (+1)
    • Save Rugan, then  convince him to surrender the cargo OR Provoke a fight with him (+1) (either option)
    • If you fail the  Intimidation check, tell Rugan you can harm him no less worse than gnolls would have (+1) (makes him hostile)

Waukeen's Rest and Zhentarim Hideout

  • Tell Counsellor Florrick that she needs to find someone else to rescue Duke Ravengard (+1)
  • Leave Benryn to die under the wreckage (+1)
    • If you saved Benryn and found the dowry before he mentioned it, tell him you'll keep the dowry as a payment for his saving (+1)

Note: If you find the dowry after Benryn mentioned it, it won't grant any approval

  • Kill Rugan on Zarys's order (+1)
    • Kill Rugan, if he survived Zarys's torture and your fight against other Zhentarim (+1)
  • After purchasing Oskar Fevras from Brem, speak to the artist and call him a slave twice (+1)

Mountain Pass and Crèche Y'llek

  • Attack Ellyka near the point of encounter with githyanki squad (+1)
    • OR, Being  disguised as a gith, provoke her to attack you (+1)
  • Speaking to Kith'rak Voss, pass the  Arcana check to find out he's using  Detect Thoughts on you, and then attack him (+1)

In the Crèche:

  • Upon entering the Créche, first tell Gish Far'aag that Voss sent you; then pretend to be an avatar of Vlaakith and succeed a  DC 30 Performance Check (+1)
  • Vandalise the portrait of Vlaakith (+1)

In the Infirmary:

  • If Lae'zel is using the zaith'isk, during the first phase convince her that the device kills instead of curing (+1)

Note: To do this, succeed a passive  DC 14 Perception Check, then succeed a  DC 30 Wisdom Check,  DC 30 Persuasion Check or  DC 30 History Check (the latter for  Githyanki only)

  • Let her proceed to the second phase, then stop the purification (+1)

Note: To do this, succeed a  DC 21 Wisdom Check or  DC 21 Persuasion Check or  DC 30 Deception Check. This choice will permanently lower Lae'zel's  Intelligence by 2

In the Hatchery:

  • Tell Varsh Ko'kuu that the last githyanki egg is clearly a dud (+1)
  • Tell Ko'kuu that if he gives you the egg, you'll sell it at best price OR make yourself an omelette (+1)

Note: Any threat of doing harm to the egg makes Ko'kuu and hatchery guards hostile

In the Classroom:

  • Offer to fight Youth Varrl when Sa'varsh Kethk asks for a challenger, and then indeed kill him (+1)

At the Captain's Quarters and Inquisitor's Chamber:

  • Tell Kith'rak Therezzyn that you have the Mysterious Artefact, then refuse to surrender it (+1) (provokes a fight with Therezzyn)
  • Ask Ch'r'ai W'wargaz how he knows so much about you (+1)
  • Ask W'wargaz what you'll get in return for surrendering the weapon (+1), and then:
    • Tell him you'll accept gold as a reward (+1)
    • Demand a reward, using class-based lines for a a  Rogue, a  Warlock or a  Wizard (+1) (either option)

Note:  Warlock characters have two different possibilities to gain an approval point here

  • Refuse to hand over the artefact to W'wargaz, then convince Lae'zel to trust you by succeeding  DC 21 Persuasion Check OR by reminding her of the zaith'isk (if you've learned the truth about it prior) (+1) (either option)
  • Steal the Blood of Lathander from the Secret Chamber (+1)

Campsite and Conversations

Raphael's deal

  • When Raphael briefly takes you to the House of Hope, choose the lines:
    • "You're mad if you think I'll make a deal with a devil" (+1)
    • OR "Then fix it. Or die by my hand" (+5) (Astarion need not be in the active party for this)
  • Discussing with Astarion the cambion's offer, say that you are not Raphael's plaything (+1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Warlock, tell Astarion that you can't fall into Raphael's trap (+1) (Wyll origin has unique line here)

Camp interactions:

  • At the very first long rest, when Astarion says he'll keep watch, answer that you'll sleep better for it (+3)
  • When he asks how you'd like him to kill you, choose any way he proposes (+5) (either option)

Note: None of these available if playing as Gale origin

  • OR Promise to spill his guts if he tries (-1), then say you'll take him down with you (+5)
  • If Arabella died, and Kagha survived, Komira will try to poison and kill the druid at the tiefling celebration. Tell Komira to slit her throat (+1) (Unique line for  The Dark Urge)
  • After Astarion prompts you to call him beautiful (cutscene with a mirror), choose any answer (including the line about "shallow praise") (+1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, confess to murdering the bard (+1)

Romance:

  • Agree to sleep with Astarion (+5) (starts the romance with the spawn)[2]
  • Offer him your neck during sexual intercourse (+10)

Note: Astarion might propose to spend a night together anytime in regular dialogue once his approval rate has come up to 40+, unless you have reached the point of camp celebration first

Other companions and camp followers:

  • Resurrect a companion with Withers's help (+1) (Works only the first time you do it)
  • At the very first long rest, tell Shadowheart to remain cautious on unfamiliar territory (+1)
  • When Shadowheart comes to the camp all not herself, choose to attack her (+1)

Note: This scene occurs only if you have missed all opportunities to recruit the cleric at the beginning of the game

  • On the next morning, suggest Shadowheart to join the party (+1)
  • Playing as Shadowheart origin, confess to Astarion about your worshipping Shar, then succeed a  Charisma roll (+1)
  • When Lae'zel intends to kill everyone before turning into mind flayers, ask her to give you the knife, then slit her throat (+1)
  • When Wyll confronts Karlach at the camp, use any line to convince him to spare Karlach (+1) (either option)
    • OR Instigate fight with Wyll (+1) (either option)
  • Tell Mizora she's not leaving your camp alive during her first appearance there (+1)
  • If you helped Minthara to raze the Emerald Grove, speak to her upon returning to the camp (+5)
  • When Kith'rak Voss wakes you up at the camp during long rest to discuss the Mysterious Artefact (after the events at the Crèche), tell Lae'zel to kill him (+1) (starts the fight with the githyanki knight)
  • Feed the Owlbear Cub when it first comes to the camp (+1)
    • Pet the Owlbear Cub in your camp after it had a nightmare (+1)

Other conversations:

  • Agree with Astarion that using illithid powers to manipulate others could be useful (+1)

Note: This dialogue is available only after using 'illithid' dialogue line for the first time in your walkthrough. The line here belongs to Custom origin (Tav); other origins may have unique formulations.

Companion quest

At the long rest, when Astarion tries to bite you:

  • Say you believe him (+5)
    • Then let him bite you without threatening him (+10)
    • OR Let him bite you but warn you'll stake him if he goes too far (+1)
  • Playing as Karlach origin, say you'd like to help if it was not for your engine (+10)
    • OR Say he can try if he wants to burn his lips off (+1)
  • Playing as Gale origin, agree but warn that he might bite off more than he can drink (+5)

After Astarion's vampirism has been revealed:

  • On the next morning, when other companions find it out, too:
    • Say you think he won't hurt anyone of you (+5)
    • OR Say that if they don't like it, they can leave (+5)
  • When discussing Astarion's future 'diet' , agree with him that feeding on your enemies sounds good (+5)
  • When he asks whose blood you'd hypothetically drink, name any other companion (including himself) (+1)
  • Discussing Cazador, promise Astarion to watch his back OR Say you'll keep him safe if he does the same (+5) (either option)

Act Two

Locations

Ruined Battlefield

If entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Grymforge:

  • Use a class-based answer for a  Barbarian, a  Vengeance Paladin or a  Sorcerer when Harper Lassandra orders you to come closer (+1)
    • OR Answer that you're a nightmare in the dark (+1)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, call yourself an escaped lunatic (+1)
  • When the Shadows warp Harper Yonas, choose to run from the fight (+1)

Note: The unique  The Dark Urge option to "Abandon them" does not bring approval from Astarion

If entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Rosymorn Monastery Trail:

  • Convince the cowardly hyena in the convoy that it doesn't belong to goblins (+1) (requires sequential  Persuasion check, and then either  Persuasion or  Intimidation check)
  • Order Warrior Gronag to fetch the bone, after he orders the hyena to do the same (+1)
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, stop Gronag. Then, when Kar'niss the drider comes, ask him about his lantern and what is there in the shadows. After the drider butchers the goblin who "fed the shadows", call it amazing (+1)
  • Convince the drider not to attack you if you killed the convoy before summoning him, using  Deception OR  Intimidation (+1) (either option)
  • Traversing Shadow-Cursed Lands with the convoy, protect them from Harpers, thus maintaining your cover as a True Soul (+1)
    • OR Side with the ambushing Harpers. Then, after defeating the convoy, tell the Harpers' leader you're going to kill them and keep the Moonlantern (+1)

Note: Immediately starts the fight with remaining Harpers. Works, too, if you managed to pick up the lantern during the battle

  • If ambushing the convoy with the Harpers, start the dialogue with Kar'niss and  deceive it into giving you the lantern (+1)
    • Then use  Deception again to convince the drider to walk away into the shadows (+1)
    • OR, Starting the dialogue, reveal the ambush to the drider and turn yourself on Harpers (+1)
  • After defeating Harpers, convince the drider that you have infiltrated their ranks to gather information (+1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Drow, snap on it and call it abomination (+1)

At the House in Deep Shadows:

  • Ask Oliver whether he doesn't have anyone else to play with, then about his parents' names, and agree to play hide-and-seek with him. Once Oliver explains the rules, tell him that you've changed your mind (+1) (Immediately starts the fight with Oliver's "family")
    • OR Agree to play and beat Oliver at the game twice without being spotted (+1) (gained after the second round)

When dealing with He Who Was:

  • Agree to find Madeline's Ledger for him (+1)
  • Order Madeline to hurt herself as Ben and Marc did (+1) (Evil  Cleric characters have unique line here)
    • Then tell her to stab herself and don't stop OR to prove she is sorry (+2) (either option)
    • Finally succeed a  Persuasion roll to keep her going (+5)

Elsewhere:

  • Talking to Dolly Thrice, ignore her pleas two times and keep the Moonlantern (+1)
  • After saving Rolan from the Shadows, tell him to shut up and be grateful (+1)
    • OR Use a class-based line for a  Barbarian, a  Bard, a  Sorcerer or a  Wizard (+1)

Last Light Inn

Speaking to Jaheira:

  • Talking to Jaheira for the first time, tell her that you are here on holiday (+1)
  • When talking to Jaheira inside the inn, refuse to drink spiked wine (+3)

Dealing with Isobel and Marcus:

  • If Marcus vouched for you at the entrance (in this case he will wait in Isobel's room):
    • Agree to help him kidnap Isobel OR Say that you are going to take the cleric yourself (+1) (either option)
  • If Marcus assaults the inn (happens if you gained entrance with Mol's help):
    • After speaking to Marcus telepathically, tell Isobel that "we follow the winged freak" (+1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell Isobel that your blood orders you to kill her, then chase off the Urge, and finally choose any line to explain your behavior (+1) (available after the kidnap attempt AND if you haven't threatened her)

Speaking to Counsellor Florrick:

  • Ask whether the Flaming Fist are just going to stay around (+1)
    • OR Tell Florrick that you have no intentions to go into Moonrise Towers (+1)
  • If Wyll is in the party, tell Florrick it's your business what had happened to him (+1)
    • OR, Playing as Wyll origin, say it was a devil deal that has gone terribly wrong (+1)

Talking to His Majesty via  Speak with Animals:

  • Say you only wanted to admire him close (+1), and then indeed choose to quietly admire him (+1)
    • OR Hiss back at him, say that he is in your territory, and order to get out (+1)
    • OR Use a class-based line for a  Barbarian or a  Ranger (+1) (either option)

Speaking to Cerys:

  • When she tells you about their misfortunes, conclude that she abandoned others (+1) (use basic line or class-based one for  Barbarian,  Fighter,  Monk or  Paladin (except  Oathbreaker))
  • Ask her what they are doing here, then tell her not to lose hope to see others alive (+1) (starts the quest, if you don't have it already)

  • Tell Orin that you're not interested in abducted companion's fate OR That you won't stop her (+1) (either option)

Speaking to Avatar of Bhaal after defeating Orin:

  • Tell  Bhaal that you have no desire to harm anyone else (+1)
    • OR Tell him that every night he possesses you your friends are in danger, and you won't stand it (+1)
  • Accept your Father's gift and blessings (+1)

Note: These options are available to  The Dark Urge characters only. Throughout the dialogue, there are several potential points where the final yes/no decision might be taken, but the result will be the same

Campsite and Conversations

After the spawn assault:

  • Tell Astarion that you are sorry for what happened to him (+1)
    • OR Tell him to move forward and get his revenge (+1)
  • Say that the world can be a wonderful place if he cares for those who care for him (+1)
  • Ask him whether you're special (+1)
  • Agree that it doesn't matter whether the other spawn have to die in the Rite (+1)

Romance:
If Astarion has completed the Rite of Profane Ascension

  • Agree to become his spawn AND to bed him "one last time, for the road" (+3)

Note: Without sexual intercourse, no approval is gained

Other companions:

  • When Vlaakith emerges at camp as a projection, convince Lae'zel to remain loyal to her (+1)
  • When Jaheira scolds Minsc after his recruitment, tell her that she could have lost the trail of the cult (+1)

Companion quest

  • When the party is attacked by other Cazador's spawn at night:
    •  Deceive Leon and Aurelia into siding with Astarion (+1) (if you know about the Rite)
    •  Persuade or  intimidate them to stand against Cazador (+1) (if you haven't learned about the Rite yet)
  • In Cazador's Dungeon, promise Sebastian to set them free OR Ask whether they would be able to control hunger (+1) (either option)
  • Successfully  talk Astarion out of performing the Rite of Profane Ascension (+3)
